name: North-star: Stacked Bars

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(OccurredAt) AS bucket,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, ContainsErrorStatus) AS errors,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, NOT ContainsErrorStatus) AS ok
FROM traces
WHERE OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
